name: usage-persistence
description: M1.15 (#26) - runs the OpenRouter fixtures (#25) through the native harness (#22) with a real ChatOpenRouter adapter and PostgreSQL checkpointer, proves what survives a checkpoint reload versus what needs out-of-band raw-response capture, and a Galley ingestion substitute (UsageIngest) that normalizes usage/citation observations with dedupe, unknown-is-not-zero, and reported/estimated/unknown cost provenance rules. See docs/evidence/m1/26-usage-persistence.md.
